title: Refund policy
text: Customers can return a bike or accessory for a full refund within 30 days of delivery, as long as it is unused and has its original packaging. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being inspected. Custom-built bikes and fitted saddles cannot be refunded, only repaired or exchanged. Shipping costs are refunded only when the item arrived damaged or was the wrong item.

title: Shipping
text: Standard shipping within the country takes 3 to 5 business days and is free for orders over $150. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $25. Complete bikes ship 85% assembled in a reinforced box; the customer attaches the pedals and handlebar. Orders placed before 2 p.m. leave the warehouse the same day. We do not ship to P.O. boxes.

title: Frame warranty
text: Every Lumen frame carries a lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects for the original owner. The warranty does not cover crash damage, rust from poor storage, or frames modified by a third party. To claim it, the customer sends photos of the defect and the serial number from under the bottom bracket. Approved claims get a replacement frame of the same model or the closest current model.

title: E-bike battery warranty
text: E-bike batteries are covered for 2 years or 500 full charge cycles, whichever comes first. A battery qualifies for replacement when it holds less than 70% of its original capacity within that period. The diagnostic is done in store with the Lumen battery tester and takes about 20 minutes. Batteries damaged by water immersion or by third-party chargers are not covered.

title: Store hours
text: The flagship store on Harbor Street opens Monday to Friday from 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., Saturday from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m., and is closed on Sunday. The workshop closes one hour before the store. On public holidays the store opens from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. and the workshop stays closed.

title: Price matching
text: We match the price of an identical new item sold by an authorized dealer, within 14 days of purchase. The customer shows the competitor's current listing; marketplace sellers, auctions and clearance sales are excluded. Price matching cannot be combined with the membership discount.

title: Assembly service
text: Store assembly of an online order costs $60 and takes 2 business days. It includes a safety check, brake and gear adjustment, and a test ride by a mechanic. Assembly is free for members of the Lumen Club.

title: Bike rentals
text: City bikes rent for $18 per day and e-bikes for $45 per day, helmet and lock included. Renters leave a $200 deposit, returned when the bike comes back undamaged. Rentals must be returned by 6 p.m.; late returns are charged a full extra day. Riders must be at least 16 years old.

title: Lumen Club membership
text: The Lumen Club costs $49 per year. Members get 10% off accessories and clothing, free assembly, and one free tune-up per year. The discount does not apply to complete bikes or e-bikes. Membership renews automatically unless cancelled 7 days before the renewal date.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards are sold in amounts from $25 to $500 and never expire. They can be used in store and online, but cannot be exchanged for cash. A lost gift card can be replaced only if the customer has the original receipt with the card number.

title: Workshop prices
text: A basic tune-up costs $75 and a full overhaul costs $180. Fixing a flat tire costs $15 plus the tube. E-bike motor diagnostics cost $40, credited toward the repair if the customer goes ahead. Most repairs are ready within 3 business days; parts that must be ordered can add a week.

title: Customer data and privacy
text: We keep order history for 6 years for tax purposes and delete marketing preferences when a customer unsubscribes. Staff may look up a customer's order only to help that customer. Card numbers are never stored by Lumen; payments are handled by the payment provider. A customer can request a copy of their data, which we send within 30 days.

title: Employee discount
text: Employees get 30% off accessories and 15% off complete bikes after their probation period of 3 months. The discount is for the employee's own use and is limited to two complete bikes per year.

title: Holiday schedule
text: During the December holidays, online orders placed after December 20 ship after January 2. The store is closed on December 25 and January 1. Returns of holiday purchases made between November 15 and December 24 are accepted until January 31.

title: Trade-in program
text: Customers can trade in a used bike in working condition for store credit worth up to 40% of its assessed resale value. The assessment is free and takes 30 minutes. Trade-in credit is valid for 1 year and only toward a new bike.

title: Financing
text: Purchases over $500 can be paid in 12 monthly installments with 0% interest through our financing partner, subject to approval. A down payment is not required. Missing an installment adds a late fee of $15.

title: International orders
text: We ship accessories to Canada and Mexico, but not complete bikes or e-bike batteries, which have transport restrictions. International orders take 7 to 12 business days. Import duties are paid by the customer on delivery.

title: Lost or damaged packages
text: If tracking shows no movement for 5 business days, staff open a claim with the carrier and ship a replacement without waiting for the claim to finish. Damaged boxes should be photographed before opening. Customers must report damage within 48 hours of delivery.

title: Helmet safety recall
text: The Lumen Aero helmet, model LA-200, made between March and June 2026, is recalled because the chin strap buckle can open under impact. Customers get a free replacement or a full refund, with or without a receipt. Staff should tell customers to stop using the helmet immediately.

title: Frame size guide
text: Riders from 155 to 165 cm usually fit a small frame, 165 to 178 cm a medium, 178 to 188 cm a large, and above 188 cm an extra large. Between two sizes, choose the smaller one for a more upright, easy-handling ride. A free fitting in store takes 15 minutes.

title: Tire pressure guide
text: Road tires run at 80 to 100 psi, city tires at 50 to 70 psi, and mountain bike tires at 25 to 35 psi. Pressure should be checked once a week, because tires lose air slowly even without a puncture. Never inflate above the maximum printed on the tire sidewall.

title: E-bike battery care
text: Store the battery between 40% and 70% charge if the bike won't be used for more than a month. Charge it at room temperature, never below 0 °C. Use only the Lumen charger. A full charge takes about 4 hours.

title: Loyalty points
text: Customers earn 1 point per dollar spent. Every 500 points can be redeemed for a $10 voucher. Points expire 18 months after they are earned. Points are not earned on gift card purchases.

title: Corporate fleet sales
text: Companies buying 10 or more bikes get a 12% volume discount and a dedicated account manager. Fleet orders include on-site delivery and a yearly maintenance visit. Quotes are valid for 30 days.
